case.title: Rehearsal · charter school ensemble against the March 3 event
case.note: A synthetic second use case: the same Troen event, a different school in play. It exists to rehearse the Stage 3 workflow with the vectors actually moving, and to prove that an illustrative case can never produce a CRM row. No record here is a researched prospect, an approach, an approval, a payment or a booking.

fact_spine.statement: Every account, ensemble, adult role and opportunity in this case is a rehearsal record invented for the pipeline, not a school Troen or this project has researched.

accounts.origin: Invented for workflow rehearsal. Charter schools are prospects on the same terms as any other public secondary school; nothing about this record is researched.
